subject: Recap & final check — Redwood / NovumAI pilot
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Green <oliver@novumai.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Recap: Redwood + NovumAI discovery — next steps

Hi Oliver —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from my side and a suggested next steps list so we stay aligned: 

1) What we heard
- Primary objective: prototype a user-facing summarization flow that reduces support handle time by ~30%.
- Key constraints: data residency for EU users not required for this pilot, but SOC2 evidence and audit logs will be needed before a production rollout.

2) Proposed pilot (2–4 weeks)
- Scope: 5k weekly requests, Redwood hosted inference using a quantized open model; integration via /v1/generate.
- Success metric: 15–30% decrease in average handle time on the pilot cohort + no PII leakage incidents.

3) Ask from NovumAI
- Share SOC2 evidence and any architecture questions for our security team.
- Confirm pilot start week and a primary technical contact.

4) Next steps (owners / timing)
- Mina: send SOW + sample prompt set (attached) — today.
- Oliver: confirm pilot timing and loop in ops/procurement for any contract checklist — by 1/22.
- Marcus: prepare an options sheet for dedicated capacity if pilot scales.

Attachment: NovumAI-SOW-draft.pdf (attached) — lightweight scope + optional reserved capacity appendix.

If this looks right I can pencil 1/26 as a tentative kickoff and schedule a 30-minute integration session with your engineer. Appreciate the time — looking forward to moving this forward if it’s still a priority.

Best,

Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Thanks Mina —

Shared the SOW and summary with our ops and security teams. We need to gather SOC2 artifacts before any exec sign-off; ops asked for a few specific logs (audit / retention) which I'll forward once we hear back.

I'll aim to update you by EOD Friday (1/23). If I don't have a full answer then, I will at least share who on our side will own the checklist.

Appreciate the clear next steps.

—Oliver

Hi Oliver —

Wanted to do one last check before we close the loop on this opportunity. We haven’t received the SOC2 artifacts or a target start date, so I wanted to confirm whether you’d like us to: 

- A) Keep the SOW live and schedule the security sync (we can be flexible on a start date), or
- B) Close the file for now and I’ll re-open when NovumAI is ready.

If I don’t hear back by EOD Friday (2/13) I’ll close the file and set the deal stage to "Deferred" in our system. No hard feelings — we’re happy to pick this back up later.

Thanks for the time so far — really enjoyed the discovery and hope this is useful even if you pause it.

Best,
